# Blender Box

> A command-line tool for running Python test scripts in Blender on an owned Windows desktop over SSH. Results and requested screenshots return to the development checkout.

Blender Box orchestrates runs, transfers declared files, and collects evidence. Scenario scripts define assertions. The host-local blendersessiond owns Blender's process lifecycle. Blender opens in a logged-in Windows desktop; this is not a headless render service or a built-in AI model.

## Documentation

- [Overview, setup tutorial, and FAQ](https://bramvr.github.io/blender-box/): Requirements, the complete desk lamp test, capture types, and recovery.
- [Command reference](https://bramvr.github.io/blender-box/commands.html): Setup, plan, doctor, run, status, and stop.
- [Source and CLI examples](https://github.com/BramVR/blender-box/blob/main/README.md): Current implementation and executable examples in Markdown.

- [Desk lamp script](https://bramvr.github.io/blender-box/examples/lamp/scenario.py): Reproducible scene construction and assertions used for the published screenshots.
- [Desk lamp payload](https://bramvr.github.io/blender-box/examples/lamp/payload.json): Declared script and viewport/window capture policy.

## Contracts

- [Run and evidence contract](https://github.com/BramVR/blender-box/blob/main/docs/architecture/0001-slice-0-run-boundary.md): Scenario result format, evidence, and cleanup.
- [Windows identity requirements](https://github.com/BramVR/blender-box/blob/main/docs/architecture/0002-slice-0-windows-identity.md): SSH and interactive-user identity.
- [Broker capability requirements](https://github.com/BramVR/blender-box/blob/main/docs/architecture/0003-session-broker-capability-gate.md): Required blendersessiond operations.
- [Windows setup ownership](https://github.com/BramVR/blender-box/blob/main/docs/architecture/0004-fenced-windows-setup-owner.md): Setup process ownership.

## Optional

- [blendersessiond](https://github.com/BramVR/blendersessiond): Companion process manager installed on Windows.
- [Automated checks](https://github.com/BramVR/blender-box/blob/main/docs/architecture/ci.md): Test boundaries and opt-in live verification.
- [Issues](https://github.com/BramVR/blender-box/issues): Report problems and follow development.
